name: two-column
description: Responsive two-column layout with WYSIWYG editors for left and right content. Displays side-by-side on desktop and stacks on mobile (768px breakpoint).

rightWidth.title: Right Column Width
rightWidth.description: CSS grid width for right column (e.g., '1fr', '300px', '2fr')

leftBackground.title: Left Column Background

rightBackground.title: Right Column Background
